title.en: Which published pump fits a grid-powered building pour?
title.zh: 有电网的建筑浇筑，先看哪类已公布泵？

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai maps building placement to electric trailer pumps. Match vertical and horizontal cells, output and aggregate before naming a model.
description.zh: 邢台河北品锦机械把建筑浇筑对照电动拖泵。先对垂直、水平、输送量和骨料，再点型号。

h1.en: Which published pump fits a grid-powered building pour?
h1.zh: 有电网的建筑浇筑，先看哪类已公布泵？

directAnswer.en: On a building site with stable power, start on the electric catalogue, not a diesel row. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints building and commercial placement on Electric 20 through Electric 60, the low-pressure 40 and 60, and HBT80-16. Electric 80 and HBT8018 are the high-rise and high-output rows. Read metres, stone and m³/h on the model page. This note does not convert floors into metres and does not name a building.
directAnswer.zh: 供电稳定的建筑工地，先打开电动目录，而不是柴油行。邢台河北品锦机械把建筑与商业浇筑写在电动20到电动60、低压40、低压60和 HBT80-16 上。电动80与 HBT8018 是高层和大排量行。米数、石子和 m³/h 以型号页为准。本页不把楼层换算成米，也不写楼名。

heading.en: Where does the building page send you?
heading.zh: 建筑应用页把你送到哪一类？

body.en: The construction solution page says building work needs continuous placement and that buyers should compare published vertical height, delivery capacity and maximum aggregate with the pour. Those three checks live on /solutions/construction and on /products/electric-concrete-pumps. Compact rural rows (Electric 15, Electric 10 Series) are a different sentence: rural self-built houses, small sites and secondary structure. Do not start a commercial building line on those compact names.
body.zh: 建筑应用页写的是连续浇筑，并要求用已公布的垂直高度、输送量和最大骨料去对照浇筑。这三步在 /solutions/construction 和 /products/electric-concrete-pumps。紧凑的农村行（电动15、电动10系列）是另一句：农村自建房、小型工地与二次结构。商业建筑管路不要从这两个紧凑名称起步。

heading.en: Which electric rows are the building ladder?
heading.zh: 建筑阶梯上有哪些电动行？

body.en: Electric 20 prints 22 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 10 MPa, 120 m / 40 m and an 80 mm pipe with 1–2 cm aggregate. Electric 30 prints 30 kW, 12–15 m³/h, fine-stone 60 m / 180 m and aggregate-13 at 20 m / 60 m. Electric 40 and Electric 50 are the medium-building pair in the selection guide. Electric 60 prints high-rise electric pumping at 40 m³/h, with fine stone 200 m / 600 m. HBT80-16 prints building placement at 50 m³/h, horizontal 120 m and delivery height 360 m. Electric 80 prints 900 m / 300 m at 60 m³/h for 2 cm aggregate. Stay on the row whose stone label matches the mix.
body.zh: 电动20印的是 22 kW、8–10 m³/h、10 MPa、120 m / 40 m、80 mm 管、骨料 1–2 cm。电动30印的是 30 kW、12–15 m³/h，细石 60 m / 180 m，13 骨料 20 m / 60 m。选型指南把电动40和电动50放在中型建筑。电动60把高层电动泵送写成 40 m³/h，细石 200 m / 600 m。HBT80-16 的建筑浇筑行是 50 m³/h、水平 120 m、输送高度 360 m。电动80对 2 cm 骨料印的是 900 m / 300 m、60 m³/h。石子标注对不上，就不要停在那一行。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Name the electric model you are comparing and the measured pipe, not a floor count. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 写明你在对照的电动型号和量到的管路，不要只写层数。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

question.en: Is a diesel pump the first building choice when the grid is stable?
question.zh: 电网稳定时，建筑浇筑是否先选柴油泵？

answer.en: No. The building pages point at electric trailer pumps. Diesel rows are published for sites without stable grid power, including rural and infrastructure placement.
answer.zh: 不是。建筑页指向电动拖泵。柴油行公布给电网不稳的工地，包括农村与基建浇筑。

question.en: Does this page turn storeys into vertical metres?
question.zh: 本页会把层数换成垂直米数吗？

answer.en: No. Match the vertical cell printed on the model. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not add a floor-height formula on this note.
answer.zh: 不会。对照型号上印出的垂直格。河北品锦机械不在本页另编层高公式。

question.en: Are catalogue m³/h figures a daily pour promise?
question.zh: 目录里的 m³/h 是日浇筑承诺吗？

answer.en: No. They are theoretical output cells. A jobsite rate still depends on the mix arriving at the hopper.
answer.zh: 不是。它们是理论输送量格子。工地速率仍取决于到达料斗的料。

answer.en: Use /contact. The factory is Hebei Pinjin Machinery, Renze Industrial Park, Xingtai.
answer.zh: 使用 /contact。工厂是河北品锦机械，邢台任泽工业园区。
